text_html:
In this last all-in-one demo video of our AIO (all-in-one) concept for Bass OS Android 14, we are booting from desktop mode into kiosk mode and doing a little setup within that.
(Please ignore that Desktop mode is still enabled as that will be corrected when this POC is ready)

https://youtu.be/dZiXh6NzGeY?si=4CsKWSbkLQy4Bure
